title: Start
body:
There’s a surprise quiz,
and Lupe’s seatmate secretly offers him answers.
What should Lupe do?
[[ A. Lupe accepts the answers so he won’t fail. |option7]]
[[ B. Lupe refuses but doesn’t report it. |option8]]
[[ C. Lupe refuses and encourages his seatmate to trust their own effort. |option9]]
